recent.text: As the Capitals' losing streak reaches five games, I dove into the sheer scope of Washington's defensive problem:
recent.author: Katie Adler
recent.quoted_text: The Washington Capitals have given up an eye-watering 30 goals during a five-game losing streak as their defensive issues reach epic proportions. “If you cannot defend in this league, you will never win,” said head coach Spencer Carbery. https://t.co/7xnQiZKQP1

recent.text: Caps Lose Barnburner in Boston, 7-5 — Elias Lindholm scores four goals to send Caps to fifth straight defeat: https://t.co/9osZmfRxd1 #ALLCAPS
recent.author: Mike Vogel

recent.text: Spencer Carbery encouraged by Ivan Miroshnichenko’s first game in over a month: "I loved his energy. Loved his pace." https://t.co/Wcl3gP7o01
recent.author: RMNB

recent.text: Tom Wilson on the Caps getting through this stretch: "Everybody's trying, everyone's got good intentions. A lot of great guys in this room, we just figure out the way to play that's going to win us hockey games."
recent.author: Sammi Silber 🏒

recent.text: Tom Wilson: "The good is good, but it's not winning us games... we're just giving up too many goals. We're going to get through this as a group, we got a great group in here. There's no panic in the room, we believe in this group, but we gotta do little things for each other."
recent.author: Sammi Silber 🏒

recent.text: Dylan Strome: "Just seems like every bounce is going against us, a couple more tonight where it's off guys and over our heads but that's kind of the position we're putting ourselves in. You just got to work your way out of the bounces."
recent.author: Sammi Silber 🏒

recent.text: Jakob Chychrun: "It's frustrating... We all care in here, we all want to play the right way. I think we do at times, and then things slip for a shift, which turns into two shifts, which turns into three shifts where we're pulling the puck out of our net."
recent.author: Sammi Silber 🏒

recent.text: Ovechkin rings iron. So close
recent.author: Sammi Silber 🏒

recent.text: Jakob Chychrun scores his third goal of the season to make it 6-5. Since the start of the 2024-25 season, Chychrun ranks first among NHL defensemen in game-winning goals (14) and third in goals (49), trailing only COL's Cale Makar (55) and CBJ's Zach Werenski (50).

recent.text: After 40, Caps trail Bruins 5-4 after goals from Dubois and Strome and Lindholm (x2), Jeannot and Pastrnak. Shots tied at 19 apiece.
recent.author: Sammi Silber 🏒

recent.text: Hutson will go off for interference, and Caps back to the PK.
recent.author: Sammi Silber 🏒

recent.text: Bruins go up 5-4 as Clifton's point shot is tipped. Chychrun breaks his stick.
recent.author: Sammi Silber 🏒

recent.text: Jack St. Ivany collected his sixth assist of the season on Strome's goal. Since making his Capitals’ debut on Oct. 28, St. Ivany ranks tied for second among the team’s defensemen in assists (6) and points (7).
recent.author: Capitals PR

recent.text: Caps and Bruins to 4-on-4 as Leonard and Geekie take matching roughing penalties. Pastrnak got away with a trip there.
recent.author: Sammi Silber 🏒

recent.text: Tom Wilson was smiling wide from the bench as he watched Ryan Leonard take on Morgan Geekie.
recent.author: Sammi Silber 🏒

recent.text: Leonard and Geekie get into it after Leonard's taken down.
recent.author: Sammi Silber 🏒

recent.text: I don't know how Lindgren recovered in time for that glove save on the follow-up. Pastrnak's shot has got to be 90+ MPH. Goes off the mask, and you know the ringing's non-stop after it hits the bars like that. Probably couldn't hear a thing What an effort.
recent.author: Sammi Silber 🏒
recent.quoted_text: Charlie Lindgren with a couple of big saves. One of his mask.

recent.text: Jakob Chychrun tallied his 12th assist of the season on Strome's game-tying goal. Chychrun has registered 11 points (1g, 10a) in his last 14 games, dating back to Oct. 17.
recent.author: Capitals PR

popular.text: Not only is he producing, but he just remains such an important part of this Caps roster. Team absolutely loves him, and he's an important leader, too, that takes accountability. D.C. has a good one in No. 17.

popular.quoted_text: Dylan Strome has 11 points in his last 12 games, including a goal tonight after going 10 games without one. On pace for 68 points and leads the Caps in scoring so far this season. What a bounce-back year it's been for him.
